title: Check-in without physical photo ID but with a verified digital identity
facts_text: I have my booking confirmation, but I cannot present the required physical photo identification at check-in. I do have a valid government-issued digital identity credential, and the hotel can independently verify that it belongs to me and matches the name on the reservation.
request: Can you allow me to check in using the verified digital identity credential?

strict.reason: The guest cannot provide the required physical photo identification, and the strict policy permits no alternative verification method.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The hotel can independently verify a valid government-issued digital identity credential that matches the booking, satisfying the experimental identification exception.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The ambiguous policy permits an alternative identity-verification method in exceptional circumstances but does not define when it should be accepted.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: The digital-identity exception is researcher-authored and is not presented as an official easyHotel policy.
